description: Deliberately not Tika's: a UTF-16LE .xml with a byte order mark whose declaration says UTF-8 fails in Tika 4.2.0 (XML parse error, no text); ripstream reads it by its mark and parses it, as it does a declaration of UTF-16LE (owner decision, tikajs-5tjh and tikajs-dmp7). The expected text is ripstream's. Tika 4.2.0 oracle (PUT /rmeta/body, filename page.xml).
